cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stayed through the whole speech. You used to bring your shaking notes to me afterwards. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mark the thing I asked about. How often did I tell you that? I stayed at the microphone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're very thorough now. Could you give your old teacher a pass instead? Tell me I can put the notes away tonight and leave them there tomorrow.
